description: This is a unit test source file for the 'Cases' module in SuiteCRM, using PHPUnit framework. It contains test cases verifying the behavior and attributes of the 'aCase' class and related functions.

classes.name: aCaseTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the 'Cases' module's 'aCase' class in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test environment, initializes 'current_user' global variable.

methods.name: testaCase
methods.description: Tests creation of a 'Cases' bean and checks its default attribute values.

methods.name: testget_summary_text
methods.description: Verifies the get_summary_text() method returns null when name is unset, and the name when set.

methods.name: testlistviewACLHelper
methods.description: Tests ACL helper method, currently marked as incomplete.

methods.name: testset_case_contact_relationship
methods.description: Tests setting a case-contact relationship without errors.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Checks that related user names are correctly fetched for assigned, created, and modified users.

methods.name: testget_contacts
methods.description: Tests get_contacts() method; expects false when no contacts.

methods.name: testget_list_view_data
methods.description: Verifies get_list_view_data() returns expected data with default and preset attributes, including regex match for 'set_complete' HTML.

methods.name: testbuild_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Tests the generated SQL WHERE clause for string and numeric input.

methods.name: testset_notification_body
methods.description: Verifies that set_notification_body() populates the template with correct case attributes.

methods.name: testbean_implements
methods.description: Checks bean_implements() method for various extensions, including 'ACL'.

methods.name: testsave
methods.description: Tests the save() method and subsequent deletion for the 'Cases' bean.

methods.name: testgetEmailSubjectMacro
methods.description: Verifies getEmailSubjectMacro() returns the expected macro string.

methods.name: testgetAccount
methods.description: Tests getAccount() method for returning an array with empty account info.
